pyqgis_plugin.name: QGIS AI Agent Copilot
pyqgis_plugin.description: An AI-powered GIS Agent using DeepSeek LLM with native multimodal vision for natural language geoprocessing, mapping, and spatial analysis.
pyqgis_plugin.about: QGIS AI Agent Copilot is an in-application GIS Agent powered by DeepSeek LLM and native multimodal vision. It provides 64+ structured geoprocessing, remote sensing, machine learning segmentation, OpenStreetMap, and Google Earth Engine tools with fail-closed parameter validation, execution checkpoints, and project-scoped SQLite memory.
pyqgis_plugin.tags: AI, LLM, DeepSeek, Earth Engine, OSM, Geoprocessing, Automation
